Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical SMILES from molecule_dictionary joined with compound_records on molregno, then with docs on doc_id filtered by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1155460. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
